title: Campaign Monitor Review (2026)
intro: Campaign Monitor is evaluated here as email marketing software — Campaign Monitor (by Marigold) is a design-focused email marketing platform with drag-and-drop building, templates, segmentation, automation/journeys, AI writing/boost tools, analytics, and agency/multi-account features. Pricing is contact-tiered across Lite, Essentials, Premier, plus custom Enterprise; free trial is offered (no forever free plan published). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s email-marketing methodology (ease of use, email creation, automation, segmentation, analytics, deliverability tooling, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Campaign Monitor when email design quality and agency-friendly packaging matter more than forever-free entry or deepest automation.
verdict: Choose Campaign Monitor when email design quality and agency-friendly packaging matter more than forever-free entry or deepest automation. Compare Mailchimp or GetResponse for freemium entry, AWeber for simpler creator email, and ActiveCampaign for deeper automation + CRM. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Campaign Monitor emphasizes simple, powerful email for businesses and agencies — approachable builder UX with agency/multi-account complexity on higher plans.
Design-led templates and drag-and-drop building are the product’s clearest first-party strength versus automation-first peers.
Journeys/automation exist, but the center of gravity is design-quality email rather than ActiveCampaign-depth marketing automation.
Lists and segments are first-class for campaign targeting; solid for SMB/agency email programs.
Campaign analytics and benchmarks are documented; AI boost/insights appear on the product story without being a full BI suite.
Standard ESP authentication and deliverability support; not a specialist reputation-repair tool.
Ecommerce/CRM connectors and agency tooling are documented; ecosystem is competitive for SMB/agency email.
Contact bands scale with Enterprise/sales paths above large lists; Lite send caps constrain frequent senders until Essentials+.
No forever free plan and a steep Premier jump vs Essentials hold the score moderate despite Lite’s low entry floor.
AI writer/booster tools are marketed; useful but not the primary buying reason versus design quality.

bestFor: Marketers wanting AI writer/booster and benchmarked campaign insights
notIdealFor: Cost-sensitive senders who outgrow Lite’s send cap but find Essentials/Premier steep
Teams needing a full marketing CRM (sales pipeline) rather than email-first
pros: Clear Lite / Essentials / Premier contact-tier packaging
Unlimited sends on Essentials and Premier
cons: Lite send caps push frequent senders up-tier
Premier pricing jump is large at the same contact band
Automation depth trails dedicated marketing-automation platforms
Website Builder and some features may be add-ons
keyFeatures: Agency and analytics features on higher plans
limitations: No forever free plan — trial only
Lite monthly send caps force upgrades for frequent senders
Premier jump is large vs Essentials at the same contact band
Some advanced features / website builder may be add-ons or higher-tier only
Price rises sharply with contact band; 50,001+ often requires sales
pricingSummary: No forever free plan. 30-day trial. Lite from $13/mo, Essentials from $31/mo, Premier from $171/mo at 0–500 contacts (annual ~10% off). Lite send-capped; Essentials/Premier unlimited sends. Enterprise contact sales.
whoShouldChoose: Choose Campaign Monitor when email design quality and agency-friendly packaging matter more than forever-free entry or deepest automation.
whoShouldConsiderAlternatives: Compare Mailchimp or GetResponse for freemium entry, AWeber for simpler creator email, and ActiveCampaign for deeper automation + CRM.

faq.question: Is Campaign Monitor a full email marketing ESP?
faq.answer: Yes. Campaign Monitor is evaluated as email marketing / ESP software for campaigns, lists, and related automation — not as a full sales CRM of record.

faq.question: How is Campaign Monitor priced?
faq.answer: No forever free plan. 30-day trial. Lite from $13/mo, Essentials from $31/mo, Premier from $171/mo at 0–500 contacts (annual ~10% off). Lite send-capped; Essentials/Premier unlimited sends. Enterprise contact sales.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Campaign Monitor?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage.
